text:
alex_fin: Flagging an oddness in March close 9- there's a $42,300 mismatch between what our deferral schedule expects and the invoiced amount for AcmeCorp. Attaching schedule in CSV.

maria_revops: Can you call out which contract/invoice? Quick summary pls (start/end, billed vs schedule).

alex_fin: INV-98765 (see CSV). System shows billed_amount=180000 but schedule totals recognized for the term = 222300. Recognized looks like it included a month that shouldn't be live yet.
sam_salesops: We shipped amendment A-345 to add burst GPUs. In SFDC the effective_date was entered as 2026-04-01 but billing sent invoice with term starting 2026-03-01. Link: https://salesforce.company/C-2334/A-345. I think billing used the wrong start.
jordan_accounting: If billing started early, that causes the deferral schedule to shift. We need the signed amendment date/time to confirm whether revenue should begin in March or April. If signed after invoice date, we need to correct.
alex_fin: Pasted CSV snippet:
```
customer,contract_id,amendment_id,invoice,invoice_date,billed_amount,period_start,period_end,recognized_amount
AcmeCorp,C-2334,A-345,INV-98765,2026-03-20,180000,2026-03-01,2026-08-31,222300
```
(note recognized_amount is schedule total across periods; the system used 6 months clearance)
maria_revops: For close, we should book a provisional adjustment rather than wait. Propose we reverse the excess recognized for March up to $45k pending doc. Approving provisional JE up to $45,000.
billing-bot: created billing-ticket BT-778 to investigate invoice dates for INV-98765.
sam_salesops: Confirmed signed_amendment_date in SFDC = 2026-03-29. Sales prefers to issue a credit and reissue invoice with corrected term starting 2026-04-01 (no retro billing). Customer agreed.
jordan_accounting: Accounting treatment recommended: reverse March recognition for the excess $42,300. JE: Debit Revenue $42,300 / Credit Deferred Revenue $42,300. Post on 2026-03-31 close as a correction. Then apply credit memo when billing team issues it.
alex_fin: I'll prepare the JE memo and attach support. Uploading to /finance/monthend/working/AcmeCorp_INV-98765_memo.xlsx and will move to close folder by 10:30 PT.
maria_revops: Add note in ARR bridge and in contract notes: rely on signed amendment dated 2026-03-29; expected ARR impact -$42.3k for Q2 timing.
sam_salesops: Uploaded signed amendment PDF to SFDC and linked here.
jordan_accounting: Once JE uploaded I'll review and sign. Also will wait for billing to confirm CM number before final posting.
billing-bot: credit memo created CM-54321 for INV-98765; status: queued.
alex_fin: Action items summarized: (1) Sam 9 attach signed amendment; (2) Alex prepare JE + schedule; (3) Jordan review and post. Will update thread when posted. :white_check_mark:
maria_revops: Thanks team, please flag if anything else pops during close.
